bundle.shortDescription: Secure Xray client with VPN mode, kill switch and split tunnelling
bundle.longDescription: Phi2ray is a small, careful Xray client for Windows. It connects to VLESS, VMess, Trojan and Shadowsocks servers (REALITY, XHTTP, WebSocket, gRPC and more), routes the whole system through a VPN adapter or works as a proxy, and protects against leaks with a firewall-based kill switch.
